verdict.rationale: The documentation covers porting numbers into Google Voice (port orders, activation dates, losing-carrier limits), which does not transfer to porting out. Nothing documents port-out fees or lock-in, or in-app account details such as an account number or PIN for a gaining carrier. A single community remark that users ported away shows port-out happened but is not documented first-party capability for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my number out without lock-in fees, with the account details the gaining carrier needs available in the app
